transport_note: GitHub Direct can commit text receipts and pointers. It cannot upload the local TAR from Cloud Shell unless the TAR bytes are provided or committed from terminal.

next_options.terminal_commit: commit the TAR from Cloud Shell using git add/commit/push
next_options.pinata: download TAR from Cloud Shell and upload to Pinata, then verify CID
next_options.chat_upload: upload TAR here if supported, then GitHub Direct can create a base64/binary path only if connector supports it
